dataList.title:

惜春的势力
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室
dataList.content:
My lady seems to be in a... particular mood today...
小姐的样子好像和平常有所不同……

It's all useless, isn't it...
这种事，到底有什么意义……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Xi... Xichun?
惜……惜春小姐？

When these classes end and you guys all leave... I guess I'll be spending my days worried to death that an assassin could pop up out of nowhere and kill me at any moment.
反正授课结束后，只要你们一走……我就又要像以前那样，每天提防着那些对我虎视眈眈的敌人了吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Consumed by so much paranoia and worry that I'll start twitching at shadows cast from lamplights.
哪怕看见灯光照出的黑影也难消疑虑，每日提心吊胆着恐惧它什么时候会把我吞噬。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
So would it mean anything for me to... you know, prove to them that I deserve to be the Family Hierarch?
既然如此，我向他们证明自己作为家主的资格又有什么意义？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I've spent my whole life trying to prove to everyone that I have the will and determination to become the Family Hierarch... and now I have to prove to everyone that I deserve to keep it?
我这一生都在证明自己对成为家主的渴望……而现在却连自己能不能配得上家主之位都需要证明。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
To those bastards whose only thought in their empty heads is how they can expand their rooms?
而且……还是要向那群满脑子只想着如何增加自己房间的家伙们证明。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Mister Wei, have you ever heard of playing hooky before?
卫先生……您知道翘课吗？

Playing... hooky? Is it a euphemism for... eliminating your enemies?
撬……刻……？那是什么？一种清除敌人的新暗号吗？
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Well, I've rarely done it back when I was in school, but...
我上学的时候……真的有做过就是了……

... when there's too much going on in your head, you just... skip school and go out to play.
脑袋里被思绪塞满的时候，就……不想上课，想出去玩。

Oho...
哦……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Ah, I've only done it once myself, after a friend talked me into it.
啊，我只是被朋友教唆着干过一次而已。

I agree... it seems that the time for my lady to clear her head... has come.
是啊……这样的话……小姐也该是时候让头脑冷静一下了。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Very well. Let us play... just one hooky...!
那就……试着撬刻吧……！
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... What are you guys doing?
……你们在干什么？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content: C'mon, let's get moving! I gotta prove myself, don't I? I gotta have those bastards' approval, don't I? 我不是必须要证明那个又~麻烦又严苛的资格吗。快动起来。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
<She's in a really bad mood today, huh... >
<她也太消沉了……>

My lady, have you visited the backyard by the <ruby=Snow Reed>Luxue</ruby> Hermitage(蘆雪庵) as of late?
小姐，您最近有去看过芦雪庵的后院吗？
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... No, but I know what happened there. They threw in a few dead bodies from the massacre a decade ago, turned the pond foul, and decided to bury the whole thing.
……我知道那里。十年前的屠杀里有几具尸体沉到池子里腐烂了，所以干脆就把那儿全埋起来了对吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Indeed they did. The stench was so overwhelming and toxic that corpses of animals and plants could be seen floating on its surface, eventually turning the pond into a festering, black bog. People passing by had to plug their noses or risk passing out.
是的，曾经是。因为气味恶臭难闻、池水漆黑污浊，且各种动植物的尸体都漂浮在水面上，所以凡是经过那附近的人，无不掩鼻。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... So why even bring up something awful like that?
……但那些不愉快的都是往事了，现在提起来做什么。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
It seems that a tree had taken root there, my lady. Amidst all that rot.
不过，那里似乎恰好有一棵树冒了新芽，小姐。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
A willow.
原来是棵柳树。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
The willow tree reached deep into the pond with its roots, clearing it of the foul grease, cleansing the water...
当那向下生根的柳树汲取池中腐臭的油脂，净化池水后……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... and one day, we found it clear and glittering, thriving with other aquatic plants growing within.
不知不觉间，其他的水中植物都重新开始生长了。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
It's recovered from the rot, becoming a normal, clear pond surrounded by leaves and moss.
因此现在，那里已经变回了一片被青苔与绿叶环绕的普通池塘。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Some months ago, they introduced a few carps in there, and...
几个月前，我试着往其中放了几条鲤鱼……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... when they checked again, they were just as vivacious as they were on their first day there.
如今它们仍和最初的样子一样，富有活力地游动着呢。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Would you like to pay the pond a visit, if it is all right with you?
如果您方便，要去看看吗？
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
… Hmm.
……唔。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Xichun didn't seem to quite buy his explanation, but she followed him anyway.
虽然脸上带着半信半疑的神色，但惜春还是跟着卫慢慢出去了。

dataList.title:

dataList.place:

dataList.content:
You weren't kidding. I avoided this place for so long...
竟然是真的，我只是一段时间没来看而已。

... I never thought it could be this clean again.
我本以为这里再也没办法变回去了……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I can hardly believe that this pond used to be a rotten bog. All that happened was that this tree happened to take root here...
难以想象这里以前是一片腐烂的池塘。仅仅是一棵树在此扎根就能变成这样……

What matters, my lady... is patience and determination.
最重要的是……要静待花开，小姐。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Of course, this place had slipped my mind then, as I was quite swamped with work, but...
当然也有我的问题，那时候我的心思过于集中在事务上，一时疏忽了对这里的处理……
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
... the world has a stronger capacity to heal itself than one might imagine.
可世界的自我净化能力似乎比我们想象中更强呢。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
Recovery will follow, as long as there is a steady root to rally around.
只要根基稳固，剩下的一切自然会水到渠成。
dataList.title:
Xichun's Clan
惜春的势力

dataList.content:
After a long break that seemed to freshen even our hearts...
在得到令人心旷神怡的休息后……

Nice, you're making good progress.
结果还不错吧？
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Streets
大观园 街道

dataList.content:
Your form, the light in your eyes... I think you've certainly improved in all aspects.
姿势也好，眼神也好，确实都比以前要好了不少。

I daresay you've had some change of heart, too?
我大胆猜猜……应该连你的心态也有所变化吧？

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Yeah. I do feel a tad more comfortable than I did before.
嗯，和以前相比确实轻松了许多。
dataList.title:
